verdict.rationale: Fivetran's MCP server supports a FIVETRAN_SCOPE setting (read-only vs read/write vs read/write/delete) letting operators limit what an agent-facing credential can do, and Fivetran also documents role-based access control and API-key authentication for its REST API. However, there's no documented fine-grained, per-agent scoped credential issuance (e.g., token minting with custom permission sets) beyond this coarse read/write/delete toggle. Missing for 10: granular least-privilege credential scoping beyond three tiers, agent-specific credential lifecycle/rotation docs, and independent verification of RBAC granularity.
